definitions.gloss: emergency bell; alarm bell; emergency alarm
definitions.explanation: An alarm bell or buzzer installed in buildings, trains, and other facilities that is activated in case of emergency such as fire, earthquake, or crime.

examples.japanese: {非常|ひじょう}ベル⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}った→鳴る：01143_naru⟧。
{非常|ひじょう}ベル⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}して→押す：02854_osu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{火災|かさい}→火災：02561_kasai⟧⟦{訓練|くんれん}→訓練：02673_kunren⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{非常|ひじょう}ベル⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}った→鳴る：01143_naru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦{避難|ひなん}した→避難する：26827_hinansuru⟧。
examples.english: The emergency bell rang during the fire drill, so everyone evacuated.

notes:
Found in buildings, train stations, and on trains throughout Japan. On trains, it is often labeled ⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧⟦ボタン→ボタン：02963_botan⟧ (emergency button) rather than {非常|ひじょう}ベル.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {非常|ひじょう}ベル⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}る→鳴る：01143_naru⟧ — the emergency bell rings
- {非常|ひじょう}ベル⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧ — to press the emergency alarm
- {非常|ひじょう}ベル⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鳴|な}らす→鳴らす：02381_narasu⟧ — to sound the emergency alarm
